name: India
summary: India is not a contracting party to the 1958 UNECE Agreement. Lamps and retro-reflectors are safety-critical components under CMVR Rule 124 and need a type approval (TAC) including COP from an Indian test agency (e.g. ARAI, ICAT, GARC) under AIS-037. The technical requirements (AIS-012/AIS-198 for lamps, AIS-057/AIS-200 for retro-reflectors, AIS-008 for installation) closely follow UN R7/R23/R3 and R148/R150/R48 respectively, but are frozen at specific versions. An E approval shortens testing but does not replace the Indian approval.

standards.title: Central Motor Vehicles Rules, 1989 – Rule 124 (Safety standards of components) and Rule 126 (Prototype of every motor vehicle to be subject to test)
standards.scope: Rule 124: type approval and COP of safety-critical components (including lamps and retro-reflectors) by designated test agencies; Rule 126: prototype testing/type approval of every vehicle type by designated test agencies (GARC Chennai added by G.S.R. 247(E) of 15 Mar 2017).

standards.title: Procedure for Type Approval and Establishing Conformity of Production for Safety Critical Components (with Amendments up to No. 11, 03/2025)
standards.scope: Procedure for component type approval (TAC), marking (§9), recognition of E/e test reports (§7.4) and COP test scope/frequency (Annex B) for components notified under CMVR Rule 124, including imported components.

standards.title: Installation Requirements of Lighting and Light-Signalling Devices for Motor Vehicle having more than Three Wheels (incl. Quadricycles), Trailer and Semi-Trailer excluding Agricultural Tractors
standards.scope: Installation rules (counterpart to UN R48); in force by S.O. 1365(E) of 13 Dec 2004. Rev.1 is based on the ECE R48 03 series; Rev.3 (June 2025) on the UN R48 06 series Suppl. 15. Rev.3 approvals count as compliance with Rev.1:2010 on request. Later UN series amendments are only accepted case by case by the AISC chair (§11.2).

standards.title: Performance Requirements for Front and Rear Position (Side) Lamps, Stop-Lamps and End-outline Marker Lamps for Motor Vehicles
standards.scope: Component requirements for tail and stop lamps; based on the ECE R7 02 series Suppl. 12 (in force 10 Mar 2009). According to Amendment 1 (08/2013), later ECE series amendments are not taken into account, except case by case by the AISC chair. Being replaced by AIS-198 (transitional provisions in AIS-198 §6).

standards.title: Performance Requirements for Reversing Lamps for Motor Vehicles
standards.scope: Component requirements for reversing lamps (title per the 2015 AIS list; UN basis probably ECE R23, not checked against the full text). Being replaced by AIS-198.

standards.title: Provisions concerning the Approval of Retro-Reflecting Devices for Power Driven Vehicles and their Trailers
standards.scope: Component requirements for retro-reflectors; based on the ECE R3 02 series Suppl. 10 (in force 2 Feb 2007), with changes 'in the Indian context'. Being replaced by AIS-200.

standards.title: Uniform Provisions Concerning the Approval of Light Signaling Devices and Systems for Power-Driven Vehicles (June 2025)
standards.scope: Indian counterpart to UN R148 (original version, Suppl. 4, in force 8 Oct 2022) covering, among others, tail, stop, reversing and registration plate lamps; consolidates AIS-012 Parts 2, 4-10 and AIS-010 (Part 3); contains India-specific registration plate dimensions; §7 sets out re-testing for E/e-approved lamps.

standards.title: Uniform provisions concerning the approval of retro-reflective devices and markings for power-driven vehicles and their trailers (June 2025)
standards.scope: Indian counterpart to UN R150 (up to Suppl. 4, in force 30 Jun 2022); consolidates AIS-057 (Rev.1), AIS-022, AIS-088, AIS-089, AIS-090; §7 sets out re-testing for E/e-approved retro-reflectors.

certification.scheme: CMVR type approval (Type Approval Certificate, TAC) under Rule 124 (component) and Rule 126 (vehicle)
certification.marking: TA marking per AIS-037 §9: trade name/manufacturer's mark, manufacturer's identification code and a 6-character approval reference (letter of the test agency, e.g. A=ARAI, C=ICAT, G=GARC, N=NATRAX, V=VRDE; year code per ISO 3779; 4-digit certificate number, example 'A10864'). AIS-198 §3.3.2.1 alternatively accepts the UI marking under a UN approval; for E/e-approved components under AIS-037 §7.4 the ECE markings are sufficient (§9.5).
certification.summary: Lamps and retro-reflectors are safety-critical components notified under CMVR Rule 124: the manufacturer/importer applies to a CMVR test agency (ARAI, ICAT, GARC, NATRAX, VRDE and others) for a component type approval under AIS-037 against AIS-012/AIS-198 or AIS-057/AIS-200; periodic COP testing follows. In addition, the vehicle type is tested under Rule 126, including installation per AIS-008. India is not a contracting party to the 1958 Agreement, so E approvals are not recognised as such; however, E/e test reports can reduce the test scope (AIS-037 §7.4), although AIS-198/AIS-200 §7 still require certain re-tests.

deviations.national_requirement: Lamps and retro-reflectors are safety-critical components notified under CMVR Rule 124. Every lamp type needs a type approval (Type Approval Certificate) from a CMVR test agency under AIS-037; the test agency carries out the tests required by the notified standard with its own facilities (AIS-037 §7.3). This also applies to imported components (AIS-037 §1.1). The TAC can be limited to specific vehicle models if certain features can only be tested on the vehicle (§8.2).
deviations.suggestion: Plan for a component type approval at a CMVR test agency (e.g. ARAI, ICAT or GARC) under AIS-037 against AIS-198 (or AIS-012 Part 6/Part 7) and AIS-200 (or AIS-057), and provide drawings, technical description and samples as per AIS-198 §3.1; name the target vehicle models.

deviations.topic: E approval does not replace Indian testing (re-testing of lamp functions)
deviations.national_requirement: In deviation from AIS-037 §7.4, for E/e-approved lamps the Indian test agency must itself test the technical requirements for, among others, tail lamps (R1, R2, MR), stop lamps (S1–S4, MS) and reversing lamps (AR) (AIS-198 §7.1). Under AIS-037 §7.4, tests for parameters shared with the ECE regulation may only be skipped if the parts for India are made in the same production facilities as the E-approved export production. The test basis is AIS-198 = UN R148 original version Suppl. 4; newer UN series amendments are not adopted automatically.
deviations.suggestion: Submit the E approval documents and test reports (UN R148), but plan for additional photometric and colorimetric tests of the tail, stop and reversing functions at the Indian test agency; document that the parts for India come from the E-approved plant.

deviations.national_requirement: For E/e-approved retro-reflectors, the Indian test agency must test the coefficient of luminous intensity (CIL), colour of the reflected light, resistance to water and dirt ingress, and heat resistance according to AIS-200 (AIS-200 §7.1.1). At the rear, passenger cars (category M) must have two non-triangular retro-reflectors of class IA or IB per AIS-057 or AIS-200 (AIS-008 Rev.3 §6.14).
deviations.suggestion: Submit the integrated retro-reflector (class IA/IB) to the Indian test agency for testing of CIL, colour, water/dirt tightness and heat resistance, even if a UN R150 approval exists.

deviations.topic: Indian approval marking (TA code) instead of or in addition to the E mark
deviations.national_requirement: Type-approved components must carry the trade name/manufacturer's mark, the manufacturer's identification code and a 6-character approval reference: letter of the test agency (e.g. A=ARAI, C=ICAT, G=GARC, N=NATRAX), year code of the approval and 4-digit certificate number, e.g. 'A10864' (AIS-037 §9.1–9.2); for externally visible parts, preferably visible when installed (§9.4). AIS-198 §3.3.2.1 requires the approval mark per AIS-037 and alternatively accepts the UI marking; E/e components under AIS-037 §7.4 only need the ECE markings (§9.5).
deviations.suggestion: Reserve a field for the Indian TA code (e.g. 'A' + year code + certificate number) next to the trade name and part identification on the lens or a non-removable housing part, or show that the E/UI marking is sufficient under AIS-037 §9.5 or AIS-198 §3.3.2.1.

deviations.topic: Periodic COP testing by an Indian test agency
deviations.national_requirement: For lighting and light-signalling devices of classes M/N, COP tests (photometry, colorimetry) are required every 2 years; for retro-reflectors, photometry, colorimetry and water tightness, also every 2 years (AIS-037 Annex B, items 12 and 13).
deviations.suggestion: Budget for recurring COP tests (photometry, colorimetry; for the retro-reflector also water tightness) every 2 years at the approving Indian test agency and keep production samples available for them.

deviations.topic: Registration plate lamp: India-specific plate dimensions
deviations.national_requirement: According to its introduction (§0.3), AIS-198 contains India-specific registration plate dimensions. The luminance measuring points for registration plate lamps refer to category 1a (tall plate 340 x 200 mm) and category 1b (wide plate 500 x 120 mm) (AIS-198 Annex 3, §3).
deviations.suggestion: If the lamp includes registration plate lighting: demonstrate the illumination for the Indian plate formats 340 x 200 mm and 500 x 120 mm per AIS-198 and adjust the optics or mounting position if needed.
deviations.notes: The Indian dimensions are confirmed in the full text of AIS-198; the exact difference from the dimensions in UN R148 was not checked against the UN text (the UNECE website could not be accessed). Only affects the test product if it includes a registration plate lamp.
